purpose: Replace the fixed bottom-10-percent trigger with a single independently calibrated A0-support threshold.

threshold_learning.trigger_rule: trigger A2 if A0 support_probability < tau
threshold_learning.primary_objective: maximize DeepSeek Relaxed score on calibration data
threshold_learning.validation: five-fold nested threshold selection: learn on four video folds and evaluate on the held-out fold
threshold_learning.final_freeze: fit once on all 500 only after nested validation is non-negative; never use Full-5320 labels
threshold_learning.sensitivity: report neighboring threshold operating points without selecting on Full-5320
